items.headline: New CTRM Market Sizing Report Released
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory published its 2026 CTRM Software Market Sizing Report, examining how the global commodity trading and risk management software market's size and structure are evolving.

items.headline: Tether Expands Into Commodity Trade Lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has moved into commodity trade lending, reportedly extending roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders with plans to expand this significantly further.

items.headline: ESMA Consults On Simplifying Trade Reporting
items.summary: ESMA is consulting on streamlining overlapping EU transaction reporting under EMIR, MiFIR, SFTR and REMIT, aiming to cut duplication and compliance costs for commodity market participants by 19 September.

items.headline: Canal And Rhine Disruptions Squeeze Shipping
items.summary: Shipping desks face compounding disruptions: Panama Canal draught restrictions are adding to congestion, Rhine barge traffic is impaired, and container rate increases are spreading from spot to contract markets.
